translationRepairs: When Yixin schemed against the crown prince, Yulili did much to make it succeed; he was then put in charge of Northern Court privy affairs and granted the title Meritious Subject of Sincere Support.

When Yixin schemed against the crown prince, Yulili did much to make it succeed; he was then put in charge of Northern Court privy affairs and granted the title Meritorious Subject of Sincere Support.
賜推誠協贊功臣 grants an honorific whose 功臣 is English Meritorious Subject; Meritious is a misspelling, and Meritorious Subject of Sincere Support correctly renders the title without changing other sense.
When Yixin plotted against the crown prince, Yulili greatly helped bring it about; he then administered Northern Court privy affairs and was granted the title Meritious Subject of Sincere Support.
